name: PulseX V1
description: PulseX enables you to exchange tokens ("PRC20s") on PulseChain for one another

methodology.UserFees: User pays 0.29% fees on each swap.
methodology.Fees: All fees comes from the user.
methodology.Revenue: All revenue generated comes from user fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 0.04% goes to an address which you can have no expectations (~14% of fees).
methodology.HoldersRevenue: 0.25% (~86% of fees) is used to buy and burn PLSX.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: LPs receive 0% of the fees. The only incentive is INC token emission.
